title: Glass Steppe: Industrial Logistics

foundation.history: A forgotten shattered outpost once protected ceramic heat tiles, until recurring glass-shard gales forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Vera Bell, a engineer, must restart a failing supply corridor, relying on production-chain balancing despite glass-shard gales.
central_conflict: a brittle monopoly threatens the shattered outpost by restricting ceramic heat tiles.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: glass-shard gales destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: a brittle monopoly contests access to ceramic heat tiles
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Open council administers ceramic heat tiles
Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
